findings.message: The param tarefaId selects a record (select:tarefasParaAcao) but no request fetches a single task and no selection method was defined. Added public setSelectedTarefa(id|null) and the getter tarefasParaAcao that returns the loaded row with that id; an unresolvable id publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarTarefasParaAcaoError.
public setSelectedTarefa is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public tarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
